scope: Six uniquely assigned per-cut emblem corrections; original sources preserved, runtime integration handled separately.
notes: All six source PNGs were decoded with pngjs before generation: every pixel alpha255, no source transparency. Each target and supplied emblem visually inspected with view_image original detail.

assets.placement: Place a red-and-white circular embroidered SORA patch about100pixels across on the sound technician's visible mint-green jacket upper back, centered around x44%,y35%. Retain his wiring task, chair, cat, reel deck, synthesizer, microphone, rain window and all studio equipment.
assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: SORA CARS pixel-art narrative game cutscene. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is the exact supplied SORA emblem reference. Add only one clearly readable physical emblem in the specified place. Faithfully reproduce the geometric reference: a red circular disk with two equally long thick straight white horizontal bars, a centered straight white vertical stem, and two thick straight-edged white diagonal cutouts opening completely THROUGH the lower-left and lower-right circle edge, leaving the red lower central wedge. Do not substitute a font character, curved calligraphy, short upper bar, closed red rim across the diagonal exits, floating watermark or text. Keep the complete mark above the bottom quarter of the image. Preserve every character's face, hair, expression, pose and hands; every story prop and document; the exact wide camera and framing, scene, lighting, palette and pixel-art texture. Preserve the existing opaque image and lower dialogue-safe region. Do not crop, invent extra characters or rearrange anything.
Specific edit: Place a red-and-white circular embroidered SORA patch about100pixels across on the sound technician's visible mint-green jacket upper back, centered around x44%,y35%. Retain his wiring task, chair, cat, reel deck, synthesizer, microphone, rain window and all studio equipment.
